warnings.headline: Gale, yellow level, Hekkingen - Fruholmen, 2026-11-21T11:00:00+00:00, 2026-11-22T04:00:00+00:00
warnings.description: From Saturday afternoon north occasionally near gale force 7. Decreasing early Sunday morning.
warnings.instruction: Consider not taking the boat out: Risk of dangerous situations when in a small boat at sea. If the engine stops you can float towards land.
